can_update_at_runtime.description: Set if the value can be changed at runtime without restarting the affected daemons. Emitted as the integer 1/0 to match the existing PVE wire convention.

level.description: Config level the entry is exposed at: 'basic' for operator-visible settings, 'advanced' for tuning parameters, 'dev' for developer-only knobs.

mask.description: Match expression restricting the entry's scope; empty when the entry has no mask. Examples: 'host:foo', 'class:ssd'.

section.description: Ceph config section the entry applies to: 'global', a daemon type ('mon', 'osd', 'mgr', 'mds', 'client'), or a specific daemon (e.g. 'osd.0', 'mon.<name>').

value.description: Configured value for the key (always serialised as a string by Ceph, regardless of the option's underlying type).
